name: ThemeToggler
description: A light, dark and system theme switch, as a three-option button group or a single cycling button, with a small animated icon change. It only reports the choice; it can optionally set data-theme on the page root. It reads and writes no storage: saving the choice is up to your app.

mode.description: group shows all three options; button cycles light, dark, system.

applyToDocument.description: Sets data-theme (light or dark) on the document root. System follows the device setting live. Nothing is stored.

label.description: Accessible name of the group or button.

keyboard: Arrow keys: move between light, dark and system in the group
Enter or Space: chooses the option, or cycles in button mode
requirements: Group mode is a toggle button group with one tab stop and arrow keys; every option has a text name (Light, Dark, System) and icons are decoration
Button mode names the current choice and what pressing does, for example Theme: light. Switch to dark
Always one option is chosen; the current choice is exposed as checked state (a radio group), not by icon or colour alone
The icon animation is short, plays once per change, and is off for prefers-reduced-motion, rdm-still and isStill
Reads and writes no storage and no cookies; applyToDocument only sets one attribute on the root
screenReader: Group named Theme with Light, Dark and System buttons and which is pressed; in button mode, the current theme and the next one

use_when: A site or app header that offers a manual theme
avoid_when: When the app has a single theme
anti_patterns: Relying on the icon alone to show the state
Storing the choice without telling the user in your privacy notes
